description: Connect to Baidu Netdisk to browse and search files, manage folders and files, create share links, check storage usage, and save content or files from URLs.

display.description_en: Connect to Baidu Netdisk to browse and search files, manage folders and files, create share links, check storage usage, and save content or files from URLs.
display.description_zh: 连接百度网盘，支持文件与分类浏览、关键词及语义检索、文件和文件夹管理、创建分享链接、查询容量，以及保存文本内容或通过 URL 转存文件。
examples_en: List the files in my Baidu Netdisk root directory and show the remaining storage space
Search file names, document contents, and text in images for files related to 'Project Contracts'
Find images and videos in my Netdisk related to sunsets by the sea
Create an 'AIGC Research Materials' folder and copy the relevant files into it
Create a password-protected share link for 'Weekly Report.docx' that expires in 7 days
Save these meeting notes to Baidu Netdisk, or transfer a file from a download URL
examples_zh: 查看我百度网盘根目录下的文件，并告诉我还剩多少可用空间
从文件名、文档内容和图片文字中搜索与「项目合同」相关的文件
找出网盘里与海边日落相关的图片和视频
新建一个「AIGC 调研资料」文件夹，把相关文件复制进去
为「周报.docx」创建一个有效期 7 天、带提取码的分享链接
把这段会议纪要保存到百度网盘，或者通过下载链接转存文件
display.name: 百度网盘
